    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    # extend diagonal runs of the non-background colors along their direction
    for r,c,v in pts:

                    rr+=dr*s; cc+=dc*s
    return out

# refine toward actual test case: extend 2 diagonal run; saved function produces submitted grid
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = grid[0][0]
    # Find a diagonal run of at least three matching non-background cells and extend it
    # from its upper end toward the nearest edge.
    for dr, dc in ((1,1),(1,-1)):
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                if grid[r][c] == bg:
                    continue
                pr, pc = r-dr, c-dc
                if 0 <= pr < h and 0 <= pc < w and grid[pr][pc] == grid[r][c]:
                    continue
                color = grid[r][c]
                run=[]; rr,cc=r,c
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == color:
                    run.append((rr,cc)); rr+=dr; cc+=dc
                if len(run) >= 3:
                    rr,cc=r-dr,c-dc
                    while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                        if out[rr][cc] == bg: out[rr][cc] = color
                        rr-=dr; cc-=dc
    return out
'''
